many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

program = '''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0]); bg = g[0][0]
    def components(cells):
        seen=set(); result=[]
        for p in cells:
            if p in seen: continue
            comp=set(); q=deque([p]); seen.add(p)
            while q:
                x=q.popleft(); comp.add(x)
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    y=(x[0]+dx,x[1]+dy)
                    if y in cells and y not in seen:
                        seen.add(y); q.append(y)
            result.append(comp)
        return result
    red={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2}
    objects=components({(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)})
    for marker in components(red):
        obj=min(objects,key=lambda o:min(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b) for r,c in o for a,b in marker))
        rs=[p[0] for p in marker]; cs=[p[1] for p in marker]
        for r,c in obj:
            if len(marker)==1: nr,nc=2*rs[0]-r,2*cs[0]-c
            elif min(rs)==max(rs): nr,nc=2*rs[0]-r,c
            else: nr,nc=r,2*cs[0]-c
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: g[nr][nc]=g[r][c]
    return g
'''
